identity.name: The Unwritten Sun
identity.summary: A blank ivory codex framing a broad stepped red sun.
identity.description: Costs 6 mana per activation. Deals 25 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 8 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: Its last page waits for a sunrise the world has not yet seen.

effects.description: Costs 6 mana per activation. Deals 25 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 8 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its fire trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Black Rain Theorem, Moonwell Pebble, Orchid Eclipse, Solar Crucible, Winter Orrery into The Unwritten Sun.

visual.brief: A blank ivory codex framing a broad stepped red sun.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A blank ivory codex framing a broad stepped red sun.
